Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Bruckner Casual Wood Coffee Table, 50"W, Brown
Colors: Brown
Materials: stone
This handsome coffee table features simple lines and a warm finish that's ideal for any casual room next to your favorite chair or sofa. It's the perfect perch for your page-turner book or a serving tray. 28"L x 50"W x 20"H Rubber and poplar hardwoods; birch veneer A transitional piece with touches of modern, rustic and global styles Rattan adds texture to your room along with storage space Assembly in 30 minutes or less; assemble and attach bases Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
